title: Unnumbered population density worked example
readable: Number of persons or density per hectare = (0.56 × 10,000 × 0.5) / 9 = 311
applicability: Worked example for an area of one hectare (ha). Roads 20%, Gardens 15%, Schools (including playgrounds) 5%, Markets 2%, Hospital and Dispensary 2%, Total 44%. Area available for Residential Development = 100 - 44 = 56% or 0.56. Actual total floor area = Area for residential development × FSI. Assuming an FSI of 0.5 and floor area of 9 m²/person.
notes: Transcriber note: this formula has no printed equation number. p147-1 is a service locator, not a manual equation number. The printed result 311 is preserved without adding precision.
